messages:
alex choi: heads up — noticed a spike in requests getting routed to v2 even when clients send X-Api-Version: 1. a bunch of small customers hit higher token bills yesterday. wondering if sticky routing TTL or our fallthrough order changed in the last deploy
Priya Nair: hmm that's bad. do we have a repro example? were those requests missing the header and relying on client attr?
alex choi: i've pasted a sample curl — they were sending header but service logs show header present then later routed to v2 after a reprovisioning event:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"X-Api-Version: 1\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
```
Priya Nair: thanks. could be sticky affinity flush on node recycle. current logic is: header -> query param -> sticky_token -> default_route. If sticky window expired because instance restarted, token mapping might have been rebuilt to a default v2 target
Sam Ortiz: deploy-bot shows a control-plane rollout around 1729989000 that changed the default route selection heuristic (weighting to newer model variants). iirc we also flipped how we map quota buckets for v1->v2.
deploy-bot: control-plane: changed route-weighting-config (id: cfg-982) by priya.nair at 2024-06-18T03:10:12Z
Maya Li: product concern — v1 customers expect compatibility + consistent billing. if v2 counts tokens differently we need to map quotas or expose a console toggle to opt-out of \"auto-upgrade\" routing
Priya Nair: agreed. proposal: add a per-tenant console toggle \"force_api_version\" that short-circuits routing to the version selected (ignores fallback), plus a sticky_window override in route config. UI would be simple: Off / Prefer Header / Force Header
alex choi: prefer header sounds good but need backward path for clients that rely on implicit routing. also we should emit a telemetry signal: compat_fallback_count and per-tenant last_fallback_ts
Sam Ortiz: i'll add an alert (pager) for 5xx increase correlated with compat_fallback_count spike. also recommend a dashboard tile: % requests served by routed version (v1/v2/other) and cost delta per million tokens
Maya Li: UX for console: add a rollout slider for \"compat-preserve\" that can be used during migration (0-100%). default 0 for new tenants; for existing, keep current. show warning: \"Forcing v1 may increase latency/cost\"
Priya Nair: implementation notes: (1) keep route lookup order stable, (2) when force_api_version=true, map incoming requests to the pinned handler and ensure quota mapping uses legacy bucket mapping, (3) instrument migration metric: legacy_quota_mapped=true/false
Priya Nair: config snippet for infra team:
```
route: /v1/generate
version_preference: header,param,sticky,default
sticky_window: 7200s
force_api_version: tenant_override(false)
```
alex choi: action items: Sam — alert + dashboard; Priya — change config model & expose console toggle; Maya — add UX copy + rollout slider; me — run smoke tests for header+sticky during node recycle
Sam Ortiz: i'll own the alert and a PromQL snippet: `sum by(version) (increase(requests_total{compat_fallback=\"true\"}[5m]))` and add a panel in infra dashboard
Maya Li: i'll draft copy in the console: short help text + an inline link to migration docs. want to avoid burying the toggle under advanced settings
Priya Nair: let's schedule a 30m sync after lunch to lock on rollout plan. thanks all :thumbsup:
